column1: # The version pins that no Renovate manager moves, each with where it is, why Renovate does not move
# it and how it is moved. scripts/check-renovate-pins fails for a pin that Renovate does not extract
# (.renovate/extracted.tsv) and this list does not hold, for an entry whose pin is not in its file,
# and for an entry that Renovate now extracts.
# Columns, separated by tabs: file, a string that names the pin in that file, why, how.

column3: the SHA-256 of the runner's linux-x64 package, which only the release's notes give, so no datasource carries it
column4: when Renovate moves actions_runner, set this to the checksum the release's notes give in the same pull request, or ci-host-setup refuses the package (docs/runbooks/ci-host.md)

column3: the engine's image moves with the dagger CLI pin in mise.toml, which has no datasource, so its tag and digest are not moved on their own
column4: set it with the dagger pin: mise.toml's http:dagger version and checksums, engineVersion in .dagger/modules/ci/dagger-module.toml and this image's tag and digest, one release, one pull request

column3: the key of the tools image's inputs, a hash of files and values that no datasource knows
column4: written by just tools-image-pin, together with ci_tools_image (README, The tools image)

column3: the digest of the tools image the tools image workflow published for those inputs, known only after the workflow has run
column4: written by just tools-image-pin <digest> on a branch from main once the image's signature verifies (README, The tools image)

column3: Dagger 1.0 betas are published on dl.dagger.io, not as release assets mise's registry knows, so Renovate has no datasource for the pin; its per-platform checksums change with the version
column4: moved with the dagger_engine pin, as that pin's steps say; the checksums are those of the release's checksums.txt

column3: the engine version the module is built for, which no manager reads and which must be the dagger CLI's
